traits.smithy.api#documentation:
You can use the Billing API to programatically list the billing views available to you for a given time period. A billing view represents a set of billing data.

The Billing API provides the following endpoint:

https://billing.us-east-1.api.aws

Endpoint.documentation: Override the endpoint used to send this request

Region.documentation: The AWS region used to dispatch the request.

UseDualStack.documentation: When true, use the dual-stack endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not support dual-stack, dispatching the request MAY return an error.

UseFIPS.documentation: When true, send this request to the FIPS-compliant regional endpoint. If the configured endpoint does not have a FIPS compliant endpoint, dispatching the request will return an error.

Private Pricing contracts let eligible payer accounts manage private pricing agreements with Amazon Web Services. This operation associates a private pricing contract with the caller's Amazon Web Services account. The caller must be a payer (management) account listed on the contract. This operation is idempotent, so retrying a request that already succeeded is safe.
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the contract to associate with your account.
